questions.corrige_markdown:
Subtract the entries in the same positions:

$P-Q=\begin{pmatrix}2-(-3)&1-1\\5-(-2)&4-4\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}5&0\\7&0\end{pmatrix}$.

**Answer: $P-Q=\begin{pmatrix}5&0\\7&0\end{pmatrix}$.**

Multiply every entry of $P$ by 2, then add $Q$:

$2P=\begin{pmatrix}4&2\\10&8\end{pmatrix}$.

$2P+Q=\begin{pmatrix}4+(-3)&2+1\\10+(-2)&8+4\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}1&3\\8&12\end{pmatrix}$.

**Answer: $2P+Q=\begin{pmatrix}1&3\\8&12\end{pmatrix}$.**
